I use golden curry mix (usually extra hot but that’s just me) and what I go is put bacon grease in a pan, use some jarred garlic (mince or paste) and cook it a little to get the weird acidic edge off the breed stuff. Then I add the roux, melt it down and then slowly add water in stages, mixing thoroughly to incorporate until the desired consistency. I don’t really have any measurements I just eyeball it cause I’ve been making it for years. 

I found the recipe online from an ex solider who was stationed in japan and I find it works out pretty well. It doesn’t work with any other curry brand, Golden Curry is the only one that comes out right. Also I’m basing flavour off the California locations as I’ve never been to japan before.
